request.style: English, Armenian sacred chant, solemn mixed choir and a soprano soloist, a duduk melody over a sustained drone, ancient modal harmony, stone church reverb, mournful yet steady, 58 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord
Lord, hear my voice
Let your ears be attentive
To my cry for mercy

[Chorus]
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen for the morning
More than watchmen for the morning

[Verse]
If you, Lord, kept a record of sins
Lord, who could stand
But with you there is forgiveness
And in your word I hope

[Chorus]
My soul waits for the Lord
More than watchmen for the morning
More than watchmen for the morning

[Outro]
With the Lord there is steadfast love
